review_candidates.title: Senior Oracle Apps DBA
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description: Install, configure, administer, patch, and upgrade OFSAA/OFSAAI applications and infrastructure. Install, administer, patch, and upgrade Oracle Database, WebLogic Server, Oracle Fusion Middleware, and OHS. Perform Linux administration, database backup/recovery, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. Configure and maintain application security, including SSL/TLS certificates, Oracle Wallets, user roles, and authentication. Support OFSAA deployments, batch monitoring, production
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. 3+ years of experience as an Oracle Apps DBA / OFSAA Technical Administrator. Hands-on experience in the installation, configuration, and administration of OFSAA or similar Oracle applications (ERP, Oracle CRM, or other similar Oracle applications).
